verdict.rationale: Slate is a CLI coding agent. A product of this kind could plausibly publish an API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents CLI usage, configuration, skills and orchestration, and shows no API reference or runnable API examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
